headline: Australian Wineries and Breweries Face Closures as Alcohol Consumption Falls
summary: Wineries and breweries across Australia are going out of business as falling domestic alcohol consumption creates the most difficult operating conditions in generations.
why: Wineries and craft breweries represent significant agricultural processing and regional employment contributors facing structural consumer demand shifts.

impacts.name: Alcoholic Beverages
impacts.why: Declining consumer drinking rates compress margins and increase insolvency risks across domestic producers.
